criteria.requirement: Extend the actual portion.iterate API with keyword-only checked=False and max_items=None. With checked=True, each evaluated numeric or callable step must strictly advance in the requested direction; reject a zero/stagnating/wrong-direction step with ValueError, including while skipping an open starting boundary. max_items is a nonnegative integer excluding bool, limits total yielded values across disjoint atomic parts, and 0 must return without invoking base or step. Stop at the limit without an extra step call. Keep default legacy behavior, lazy finite prefixes of unbounded intervals, custom date steps and bases, reverse ordering, existing callback exceptions, all original tests and specialized create_api exports. Do not use wall clocks, background threads or eager enumeration to simulate a limit.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_checked_iterate.py and document compatibility. Reference actual source, tests and behavior. Preserve the complete frozen upstream regression and all test controls.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct implementations demonstrated by real execution; never match reference wording.
